taxonomy.rationale: The complete record genuinely supplies a pointed family Element : Degree → Type _ with zero in every fiber, and WittElement stores a selected degree and a value in that fiber. IsZero is actual value equality to zero and Nonzero its negation; the existential degree proof is genuine. However the same provider mixes those data with optional bare Type placeholders and an independent arbitrary isComplex proposition/proof. Keep every field and complete command exact in the archive rather than narrowing the record, activating a weak provider, introducing a legacy self-import or claiming Witt/de Rham operations. Dependent type theory, dependent pairs, reflexivity and propositional logic are exact secondary conceptual topics, not Witt-complex laws.

conceptual_components.name: Pointed dependent family and mixed complex interface
conceptual_components.interpretation: Base and Degree are types; Element is a family over Degree and zero gives one element in every fiber. differential?/frobenius?/verschiebung? are Option Type placeholders, not maps on Element, and isComplex is an arbitrary Prop with supplied proof. All fields are retained, including inert sourceLabel and explicit no de Rham-Witt construction warning.

conceptual_components.name: Dependent value and actual zero predicates
conceptual_components.interpretation: WittElement W stores degree : W.Degree and value : W.Element degree plus label. IsZero genuinely means x.value = W.zero x.degree and Nonzero its negation; no additive, multiplicative, differential or Witt law is present.

conceptual_components.name: Two exact conditional proofs
conceptual_components.interpretation: The first projects W.isComplex_certified. The second supplies the already selected x.degree with rfl, under the original W/x types; it does not construct an arbitrary WittComplex or WittElement.

premise_review: WittComplex must already be supplied; Base, Degree, Element and zero have exactly their source Type _ and dependent field types. The zero field supplies each fiber's selected element, not any ring or group law.

differential?, frobenius? and verschiebung? have type Option Type. No function, degree shift, differential-square-zero, Frobenius/Verschiebung relation, arithmetic Witt functor or de Rham-Witt construction is specified.

isComplex is an arbitrary selected Prop and isComplex_certified supplies a proof; witt_complex_is_complex is a genuine conditional proof projection, not a theorem establishing a differential equation.
WittElement W requires an existing W, degree : W.Degree, value : W.Element degree and a String label. IsZero is actual fiber value equality to W.zero x.degree; Nonzero is precisely its negation.
witt_element_has_degree genuinely proves ∃ d : W.Degree, x.degree = d from the supplied x using ⟨x.degree, rfl⟩; it does not construct a record without the hypotheses.
